confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief. Confirm whether LH-02 (scoop 2) at TJ-N522-15 is stopped or operating. Radio at 09:30 says it is stopped. CMMS OT-5001 shows it closed 20 min ago as 'equipment operational'. Also ask whether it can load right now.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 at TJ-N600-09 is down. Radio and CMMS agree (OT-5100, hydraulic, repaired on site, 3-5 h, likely 4 h). Norte is truck-limited rather than loader-limited. It has 3 trucks hauling about 70 t/h (my estimate from the 574 t hauled so far across all mines) and a 242 t stockpile. LH-03 alone mucks about 36 t/h at 220 m, so the stockpile and LH-03 together cover truck demand to 17:00 (about 512 t supply against about 525 t demand). A loan would add roughly 0 to 20 t, which is under 8 oz. The only loader that can reach Norte is LH-10, which is in preventive maintenance until 11:00. After about 0.6 h of travel it would arrive near 11:40 and be partly wasted. Pulling LH-08 or LH-09 would cost development oz (0.2 or 4.0 per hour) for little gain. Radio and CMMS disagree on LH-02 at TJ-N522-15, so rule CONFIRM-01 means I move nothing for that place and ask the area chief. If LH-02 is confirmed down, I will re-evaluate loaning LH-10 to Norte after 11:00. I made no reserve activations, because no stope is stopped. Net change versus doing nothing is 0.
